'''Adar 18 (April 30)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - At dawn, a female [[Darkfriend]], [[Mili Skane]], tries to kill [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]]. On the [[Caemlyn Road]], Rand and Mat hide through a hole in the hedge from a group of merchants' guards. [[Hyam Kinch]] gives them a ride. They pass [[Carysford]] after dark, and sleep in a haystack.
